#### Kashef Qaadri is a dedicated public servant and community advocate who has devoted his career to strengthening civic trust and ensuring that every resident has a voice in shaping Dublin’s future.
# RE-ELECT
# 〰️
# KASHEF QAADRI
# 〰️
RE-ELECT 〰️ KASHEF QAADRI 〰️
DONATE TODAY
#### Since being elected to the City Council in 2022, and serving as Vice Mayor in 2025, Kashef has led with integrity, transparency, and a deep commitment to collaborative governance.
He is widely recognized for bringing people together to address complex challenges—including housing affordability, infrastructure investment, and sustainable growth—through thoughtful, inclusive, and data driven solutions.
At the county and regional level, Kashef serves as President of the Alameda County Mosquito Abatement District (ACMAD), where he leads critical public health and environmental protection initiatives that safeguard community wellbeing. His leadership reflects a strong belief that public service must be proactive, evidence based, and centered on prevention & equity.
Kashef also represents Dublin and the broader region on influential policy and leadership bodies, including the National League of Cities, the Asian Pacific American Municipal Officers (APAMO) Caucus, and the League of California Cities Community Services Policy Committee. Through these roles, he advocates for local priorities at the state and national level, helping secure resources, influence legislation, and elevate the voices of diverse communities.
His regional and community leadership includes service on the Federal and Military Communities Committee, the i-GATE Board, Dublin Pride – Integrity in Action, the Dublin San Ramon Services District Liaison Committee, and the Finance and Investment Committee. In each role, Kashef brings a practical, solutions-oriented mindset focused on fiscal responsibility, community resilience, and broader sustainability.
Throughout his public service career, Kashef has demonstrated a consistent commitment to housing stability, public safety, access to education, and neighborhood quality of life. His earlier civic work includes leadership with the Tri-Valley Affordable Housing Committee, the Association of Bay Area Governments General Assembly, the Alameda County Housing Authority, the Alameda County Fire Department Advisory Committee, and the Alameda County Library Advisory Commission.
Guided by empathy, integrity, and a belief in shared progress, Kashef Qaadri continues to lead with purpose—working every day to build a more inclusive, connected, and prosperous community for current and future generations.
